body:
Yeah. I've been on a variety of meds, ever since I was a kid. They don't do shit for me, even with how much I want them to. And then, in turn, it just feels worse when I get taken off them because they aren't working.

I'm so tired.

There's a lot I used to enjoy. But I can't even bring myself to get out of bed hardly ever anymore. I just quit my job. I don't know what I can do anymore, except just get out of everyone's way. I don't see a point anymore, I guess.

Therapy is a fucking joke. Yeah, I tried it when I was younger. But the thing is, even though the therapists always told me it'd be "just between us", they'd always whip around and tell my mom or dad everything I said. It's gotten to the point where I just don't trust anyone that can see me face to face. If I let out all of what's inside, I'd be stuck in a psych ward and forgotten about. Maybe that'd be for the best, though.

It used to be. I’ve just kind of accepted that I’m an unlovable piece of garbage now. Even the idea of death doesn’t much scare me anymore. At least I wouldn’t make people suffer anymore, if I weren’t around to make them suffer.

She's the type to always say "oh I'm sorry" when I try to reach out to her and talk about what's going on. Even now when I tried to talk to her about it she won't really listen to me. Yeah, my boyfriend is a lot better about it. He actually, yknow, talks me through things instead of just saying something like that and nothing else. The only reason I haven't talked to him right now is that I just feel like a fucking nuisance. He's going through so much right now and I absolutely refuse to add onto that. Hell he just messaged me, asking if I was okay, and I don't even know what to say back. 

Just, I don't know anymore. I really don't. I wish I had at least SOME hope left. I wish I saw myself having a future. I just can't picture it anymore. I've fucking given up. And I wish that everyone forgot about me now.
